changes:
Updated Summary of Changes endpoint with defined default ordering for pagination.
Default ordering for SOC is schedule_code desc, source_schedule_code desc, changed_table asc, changed_type asc, table_keys asc.
Modified some values response precisions so odd results do not occur in various values. e.g. 12.780000000000001 will now display as 12.78.
Fixed OData Filtering that was not allowing decimal values to be filtered.
Added Response Header definitions to the Open API Documentation.
Added New Endpoint: medication-charts.
Added New Endpoint: item-chart-eligibilities.
Updated the item-overview endpoint to contain new record information from the medication chart and item chart eligibilities endpoints.
Added the provided 'filter' parameters content to the response body meta content information.
Improved performance of the item overview endpoint when filtering response content.
Added INNOVATOR_INDICATOR column to the Items endpoint
ORIGINATOR_INDICATOR within the Items endpoint data has been fixed to reflect the correct information

Parameter filtering using csv now uses correct standard format handling.
e.g. a,b will be treated as two fields a and b to filter against. "a,b" will be treated as a single parameter field without splitting the string and the comma will be included in the search.
In addition quotations can be included by passing in double quotes. e.g. "a,b and ""some string""" will be treated as 'a,b and "some string"' being passed in to the filter search with quotes included.
Modified Error Response structure to be more consistent. 'source' element type within the response body added to more error messages
Added 'id' field to some error response messages and further additions to error response to assist in issue resolutions.
The changelog release notes for v3 releases have been added to the developer portal.

The Swagger specification in the developer portal has been updated to include the SQL data type. this information is available within the description text along within the new 'x-sql-server-datatype'  extension property available within the OpenAPI specification file.
The Swagger specification has been updated to include the maxLength property information for string datatypes.
LI_SUBSTITUTION_GROUP_ID field has been added to items endpoint
Therapeutic Group Title/ID content in items endpoint has been updated to reflect accurate information
Backend Deployment Infrastructure Modifications.
Response sorting functionality has been added to conform with the government API standards.
'moa_preferred_term' field added to the items endpoint which display the Legal instrument terminology in plain text for the Manner of Administration.
Response ODATA filtering functionality has been added to conform with the government API standards.
NON_AMT_CODE column added to item_amt endpoint.
Added New column 'written_authority_required' added to /restrictions endpoint along with corresponding applied value when applied.
Proportional_Price (PREMP) column added to items and items overview endpoint.
PBS_PREFERRED_TERM column added to item_amt endpoint.

New columns for additional data have been added to the /item-dispensing-rules relationship table to facilitate with various fee and mark-up information.
This data is now being provided explicitly, rather than requiring to be derived.
Here is the list of added columns (FEE_DISPENSING, FEE_DISPENSING_EX, FEE_DISPENSING_DD, FEE_WATER, FEE_CONTAINER_INJECTABLE, FEE_CONTAINER_OTHER, FEE_SAFETY_NET_RECORDING, FEE_SAFETY_NET_RECORDING_EX, FEE_EXTRA, FEE_CHEMO_FLAT_WHOLESALE, FEE_CHEMO_PREP, FEE_DILUENT, SUBMITTED_PHARMACISTS_PACK_PRICE, MAX_GENERAL_PATIENT_CHARGE, MN_PRICE_DISPENSER, MN_PRICE_WHOLESALE_MARKUP_LIMIT, MN_PRICE_WHOLESALE_MARKUP_CODE, MN_PRICE_WHOLESALE_MARKUP, MN_PHARMACY_PRICE, MN_PHARMACY_MARKUP_LIMIT, MN_PHARMACY_MARKUP_CODE, MN_PHARMACY_MARKUP)
Adding items overview example in swagger document.
TPUU information added to the AMT item endpoint.
The 'preferred_term' field in item-amt endpoint, which now contains either AMT or non-AMT preferred term information based on the content type, should not be nullable.
Added 'acss_payment' parameter to the fees endpoint.The Fee that may be payable by the Commonwealth to an approved pharmacist for any ACSS eligible supply.
Added 'acss_imdq60_payment' parameter to the fees endpoint.The Fee that may be payable by the Commonwealth to an approved pharmacist for an ACSS eligible supply.
Modified the drug_name field within the items endpoint to contain the correct clinical drug name reference data. This is no longer a 1-1 match for the MP AMT preferred term.
Modified default sort ordering of the schedules endpoint to sort by the effective_date and revision_number in descending order

api/v3/item-overview endpoint now available. This endpoint contains joined full detail joined content between other related tables in a complex json structure. See https://data-api-portal.health.gov.au/ for more details.
Added Copyright details within the '_meta' response body content for all endpoints.
New optional 'fields' parameter available on all endpoints, this parameter will effect response body content to return the specified data fields provided.
Source/Target revision number added to Summary of Changes
Added 'res_position' parameter to the item-restriction-relationships endpoint. Field used to identify the positional ordering of a restriction associated to a given item.
Added 'pt_position' parameter to the item-prescribing-texts endpoint. Field used to identify the positional ordering of prescribing texts associated to a given item.
Further definition updates made to various swagger definitions. See https://data-api-portal.health.gov.au/ for more details.
Parameter filtering is now available for each field on all endpoints. Users can filter using any field across all endpoints. See https://data-api-portal.health.gov.au/ for more details.
Added a sorting to each endpoint. It first sorts the data by 'SCHEDULE_CODE' in descending order, and then applies a secondary sort based on the specific endpoint
Removed 'ds-manu' dispensing_rule_mnem from data as it is not a valid dispensing rule used.
Modified the 'dispense_fee_type_code' data for extemporaneous concepts to have a value of 'EP' instead of 'NF'.
Removed 'brand_substitution_group_id' and 'brand_substitution_group_code' data values for EFC items.
API Changelog Tracking Implemented for Major/Minor/Patch releases
Filter added to all endpoints to show the latest schedule information in descending order
New column first_listing_date added to the restrictions table
New Column 'CHANGED_ENDPOINT' added to Summary of Changes
In api/v3/items endpoint, LEGAL_CAR_IND all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, LEGAL_UNAR_IND all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, POLICY_APPLIED_INDIG_PHAR_FLAG all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, POLICY_APPLIED_IMDQ60_BASE_FLAG all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, POLICY_APPLIED_IMDQ60_FLAG all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, POLICY_APPLIED_BIO_SIM_UP_FLAG all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, WATER_ADDED_IND all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, ORIGINATOR_BRAND_INDICATOR all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, continued_dispensing_emergency all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, CONTINUED_DISPENSING_FLAG all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, SAFETY_NET_RESUP_RULE_CNT_IND all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, Determined_qty all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, PACK_NOT_TO_BE_BROKEN_IND all Null values have been defaulted to 'N' for EP Program items. All other program items have been defaulted to Y
In api/v3/amt-items endpoint,  EXEMPT_IND all Null values have been defaulted to 'N'
In api/v3/items endpoint, the values in weighted_avg_disclosed_price column has been changed to NULL

In api/v3/items endpoint, SPECIAL_PATIENT_CONTRIBUTION, BRAND_PREMIUM and THERAPEUTIC_GROUP_PREMIUM columns in the Item-Dispensing-Rule-Relationship table is set to 0.00 if the product listing has THERAPEUTIC_EXEMPTION_INDICATOR of Y/true

Any reference to RES_CODE 9999_9999_R and PRESCRIBING_TXT_ID 119998, 119997 has been removed from item-restriction-relationships, restrictions, restriction-prescribing-text-relationships and prescribing-texts tables
API definitions for all fields on all endpoints have been updated on developer portal
All Endpoint examples have been updated on developer portal
